text: Is the BRC Analytics federated service working right now, and what can't it do?
I'll check the BRC Analytics federation status directly.

## Abstract

This report answers an operational question: whether the BRC Analytics federated MCP service is currently reachable, and what limitations are known to affect its tools. The status was checked via a single call to the `brc_federation_status` tool, which contacts the BRC Analytics MCP endpoint at `https://brc-analytics.org/api/v1/mcp/` and returns live health data alongside a curated list of documented tool problems. The service reported status "healthy," version 0.29.0, in the production environment, with a health-check timestamp of 2026-09-17T21:37:32Z. Five known limitations were returned, affecting two federated tools (`search_ena_keywords`, `search_ena`), one BRC REST endpoint (`/api/v1/ena/study/{accession}`), the catalog tools as a group, and the MCP endpoint URL itself. Each limitation carries a recommended workaround (e.g., use `brc_ena_search` instead of `search_ena_keywords`; use `brc_ena_runs` instead of `search_ena`; use `brc_ena_study` instead of the failing REST endpoint). The catalog is also flagged as holding no resistance phenotypes and only two *Escherichia coli* assemblies, meaning phenotype questions should be routed to BV-BRC or CARD. The result matters because several federated tools return failures as ordinary text that can be mistaken for scientific answers.

## I. Introduction

**Background.** BRC Analytics exposes bioinformatics data via a federated MCP server. Agents call its tools to query ENA sequencing runs, assemblies, and workflow catalogs. Whether those tools return trustworthy data depends on the upstream service being live and free of known bugs.

**Literature Review.** No literature was retrieved for this query.

**Knowledge Gap.** Before the call, it was unknown whether the BRC MCP server was reachable, what version was live, and which of its tools currently misbehave.

**Objective & Hypothesis.** Objective: determine current reachability and enumerate documented limitations of BRC Analytics federated tools. No statistical hypothesis applies.

## II. Materials and Methods

**Study Design.** A single diagnostic call was routed to the BRC Analytics MCP status tool, which is the authoritative source for live version, health, and known-limitation metadata.

**Materials.** BRC Analytics MCP server (`https://brc-analytics.org/api/v1/mcp/`), queried via `brc_federation_status`.

**Procedures.**
1. `brc_federation_status()` — no arguments.

**Statistical Analysis.** No statistics. Counts reported below are the number of limitation entries returned in the `known_limitations` array.

## III. Results

**Data Presentation.**

**Table 1. Live service status (from `brc_federation_status`).**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| MCP URL | https://brc-analytics.org/api/v1/mcp/ |
| Service | BRC Analytics API |
| Version | 0.29.0 |
| Environment | production |
| Health status | healthy |
| Health timestamp | 2026-09-17T21:37:32.071166 |
| Reachable | true |

**Table 2. Known limitations returned by the status tool (n = 5).**

| # | Tool / endpoint | Problem | Recommended workaround | Verified |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `search_ena_keywords` | Sends an unquoted scientific_name to ENA; ENA answers HTTP 400. Failure is returned as tool text, so it can read like an answer. | Use `brc_ena_search` | 2026-09-17 |
| 2 | `search_ena` | Caps at 50 rows with `has_more: true`; never reports a total. | Use `brc_ena_runs` | 2026-09-17 |
| 3 | `/api/v1/ena/study/{accession}` (REST) | Answers HTTP 500 for every accession tried. | Use `brc_ena_study` | 2026-09-17 |
| 4 | All catalog tools | Catalog holds no resistance phenotypes and only 2 *E. coli* assemblies (K-12 MG1655, O157:H7 Sakai). Answers "what can I compute, on which genome," not "how many resistant strains are there." | State this plainly; route phenotype questions to BV-BRC or CARD. | 2026-09-17 |
| 5 | MCP endpoint URL | `https://brc-analytics.org/api/v1/mcp` (no trailing slash) answers 307 to a plain `http://` URL; the MCP client refuses the https-to-http downgrade, surfacing as an HTTP error. | Always call the slashed URL. | 2026-09-17 |

**Findings.** The BRC Analytics MCP server is reachable and reports itself healthy at version 0.29.0. Five limitations are documented: two affect federated ENA search tools, one affects a BRC REST study endpoint, one describes the scope of the catalog tools as a group, and one concerns the MCP endpoint URL formatting itself. Every limitation entry carries a workaround and a verification date of 2026-09-17.

## IV. Discussion

**Interpretation.** The service is up. Federated calls to it can proceed, provided the listed workarounds are used in place of the affected tools.

**Context.** The limitations disclosed are self-reported by the status tool. Two of them (`search_ena_keywords`, and the catalog tools) are specifically noted because their failures or scope can be mistaken for valid scientific answers — a routing consideration, not an outage.

**Limitations.** The `known_limitations` list reflects what the status tool has been curated to report. Undocumented issues would not appear. The health check reflects the moment of the call and does not guarantee continued availability. No independent test of each affected tool was run in this session.

**Conclusion & Future Directions.** BRC Analytics is operational; use `brc_ena_search`, `brc_ena_runs`, and `brc_ena_study` in place of the flagged federated tools, and route AMR-phenotype questions to BV-BRC or CARD. A useful next query would be a functional test of `brc_ena_runs` or `brc_ena_search` against a known taxid (e.g., 562) to confirm end-to-end behavior.

## References

[1] BRC Analytics API, live status and known limitations, retrieved via `brc_federation_status`. https://brc-analytics.org/api/v1/mcp/

## Acknowledgments

BRC Analytics for the federated MCP service and its self-reported status/limitations metadata.
